lines: Revenue was £223.9 million, up 22.2% reported and 24.2% at constant currency.
Gross margin was 58.6%; adjusted gross margin was 59.4%.
Adjusted EBITDA loss improved to £86.7 million from £117.9 million; statutory loss was £145.2 million.
PromethION product-range revenue grew 43.1%; 2026 constant-currency revenue growth guidance was 21%-25% with gross margin around 62%.
Oxford Nanopore reaffirmed its targets of adjusted EBITDA breakeven in FY2027 and cash-flow positivity in FY2028.
Revenue was £116.7 million, up 10.5% reported and 12.3% at constant currency year over year.
Gross margin increased 400 basis points to 62.2%; adjusted EBITDA loss improved to £22.1 million from £48.3 million.
Clinical revenue grew 35.4% and BioPharma revenue grew 25.0%; PromethION product-range revenue increased 15.7% year over year.
Loss for the period improved to £48.0 million from £71.8 million; cash, cash equivalents and other liquid investments were £234.5 million at June 30, 2026.
FY26 constant-currency revenue growth guidance remained 16%-20% excluding the $20 million licensing fee; FY27 adjusted EBITDA breakeven and positive free cash flow from 2028 were reaffirmed.
